messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled v2 rollout (r-7054321000) starting in ~30m. Target: 10% traffic shift to v2 for watchlist tenants: acme-corp, beta-inc, nord-ops. Operator: ops-sre. Window 2026-03-21T14:00Z→14:30Z. Auto-pause thresholds: error_rate>0.01 or p50_latency>200ms. Run /deploybot status to check.

maria: please add tenant 'redwood-legacy' to the watchlist — they reported flaky SDK behavior yesterday.

ashwin: note — EU region maintenance ends at 14:15Z. Recommend holding EU-targeted shifts until 14:20Z to avoid overlap.

julia: FYI mobile SDK schema bump v1.2.3→v1.3 introduces optional header `X-RW-Trace`. Need to ensure header parsing is case-insensitive; we hit that before.

ops-sre: seeing ~0.6% 5xx in canary HTTP logs over the last 3m, spike at 14:03Z originating from acme-corp. I'm pausing the canary.

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Rollout r-7054321000 paused at 7054321035. Reason: 5xx spike. Operator action required to proceed.

sam: copying this into the release-notes draft and the incident gist. I'll add rollback rationale and stakeholders.

maria: can we do a targeted rollback/pin for acme-corp only? minimize blast radius.

ashwin: +1. ops-sre — can you check whether this looks like KV-cache eviction or header parsing? If cache-related we can toggle quant flags server-side.

ops-sre: logs indicate NPE in auth header parsing for mobile clients missing the new header. Looks client-side. Suggest pinning affected tenants back to v1 while SDK fix is prepared.

julia: I'll ping SDK team immediately for a patch. For now agree to pin acme-corp and beta-inc to v1.

deploy-bot: Queued action: pin-tenants r-7054321000 tenants=[acme-corp,beta-inc] -> v1. Command: `/deploybot pin-tenants r-7054321000 acme-corp,beta-inc v1`

deploy-bot: Executed: pinned acme-corp -> v1 at 7054321050, pinned beta-inc -> v1 at 7054321055. Rollout remains paused.

sam: noted. Scheduling a short post-deploy huddle at 15:00Z to sync PM/SDK/SRE/eng. I'll drop a calendar invite.

maria: please add this line to release notes: "Partial rollback: acme-corp & beta-inc routed back to v1 due to header parsing failures; mobile SDK patch forthcoming."

ashwin: once SDK fix is out, recommend re-run a focused canary (2%) limited to EU region first.

ops-sre: monitoring — 5xx has fallen back to baseline after pins. Will keep eyes on auth-layer traces.

deploy-bot: Rollout status: paused -> partially-pinned. To resume manual rollout: `/deploybot resume r-7054321000 --manual-ops`.

maria: thanks team. we'll wait for SDK patch and a small regional canary before reattempting.
